reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing getBudgetableCategories selection for setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the averages, but leaves copyPreviousMonth on its own inline copy of the exclusion rules without the flag.

duplication.why: Adds no new copy, but the hidden rule now exists in two forms: the parameterised SQL in getBudgetableCategories and the unchanged hard-coded hidden check in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The flag is handled in the shared selection query in budget/actions.ts, the right place, but one month-wide action stays outside it.

scope.why: Only action signatures, the shared query and one test are changed.

maintainability.why: Most actions share one parameterised selection, but copyPreviousMonth silently ignores the new option and the setZero signature is crammed on one line.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts copyPreviousMonth keeps its own hidden/group_hidden/#fixed/goal_def checks over getBudgetData and is not given includeHiddenCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth's inline JS conditions restate the same exclusion rules that getBudgetableCategories expresses in SQL WHERE clauses.
